title: A clearer picture of Ayinou
intro: These counts reflect registered Ayinou accounts and voluntary, broad residence details. They are not a population census.
departmentIntro: Current residence only. A diaspora connection is never counted as residence.
diasporaIntro: Grouped by self-reported country of current residence.
error: Community statistics are unavailable right now.
empty: No eligible members yet. The community picture will appear as people join.
privacy: Location details are shown only when every nonempty group has at least 10 members. All geographic figures are hidden together when a smaller group exists.
definition: Active means a successful signed-in profile visit or edit in the last 30 UTC days. Verified counts approved member identity or notable-person records only.
footnote: Synthetic, deleted, anonymous, banned, and disqualified accounts are excluded. Counts may be hidden for privacy.
